author: Cryo_
quote: What happened to GTA??? HUGE disappointment. The gameplay itself is good when not having performance issues or glitches. BUT the story and open world are soo boring... the storyline is no joke: a relationship simulator. The 'new' features get boring fast like scuba diving or random npc reactions. You are also limited in what you can steal and the game forces you to uphold a good relationship with the partner instead of doing it solo. Overall if I could refund it I would. Not worth the investment. Only thing that can save this game is maybe a good online experience but otherwise this is hot garbage. What happened to GTA??? You know, when it would be about crime, theft, espionage with some dark humour and fun throughout. This is just a snore fest boyfriend simulator where still 6hrs into the game you are doing quest to fix/improve a relationship. Yawn.
